Inglewood, California
  March 16, 2021

The Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting
on Tuesday, March 16, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint
Powers Authority at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Joint Powers
Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority officials and
personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint Powers
Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired
if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor
Agency/Housing Authority/ Joint Powers Authority on any item on the Agendas.

Caller (Name Unknown) commented on the Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item Nos. 8,
renewal of an agreement with Enerwise Global Technologies, Inc. dba CPower
(CPower), and O-1, Adoption of Ordinance No. 21-05 granting Golden State Water
Company a franchise to use or lay and use pipelines and appurtenances to transmit water.
She also spoke concerning the feedback she receives when she calls.

Gil Mathieu, District 4, commented on the Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item Nos. 4,
adoption of Resolution No. 21-77, ratifying appointments to the South Bay Workforce
Investment Board (SBWIB), and 5, First Amendment to Agreement No. 20-169 with
Environmental Science Associates (ESA).

MINUTES. It was moved by Joint Powers Authority Member Dotson, and seconded by
Joint Power Authority Member Padilla, that the Minutes for the Joint Powers Authority
Meeting held on July 21, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried by the following
roll call vote:
Ayes: Joint Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Joint
  Powers Authority Chairman Butts;
Noes: None.

There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts declared the meeting
adjourned at the hour of 2:40 p.m.
